Website Policies & Terms of Service – Digital Transition Marketing (DTM)
1. Service Level Agreements (SLA) & Support

DTM operates under three distinct service tiers with specific support response guarantees:

Tier	Name	Support Response
Entry	Tactical (Entry Strike)	Standard 48-hour response via Slack or email
Mid	Strategic (Optimal Assault)	Priority 4-hour emergency support SLA
Top	Sovereign (Total Conquest)	1–2 hour priority support, including weekends
2. Performance & "Blood in the Water" Guarantees

DTM provides contractually backed performance milestones:

90-Day Performance Clause ("Blood in the Water")
If agreed KPIs are not achieved within 90 days, DTM re-engineers the approach and works at no cost until targets are hit.

YouTube Ad Guarantee (Strategic Tier+)
3X ROAS guaranteed within 90 days. If missed, DTM provides 50% refund of fees or continues work for free until achieved.

Money-Back Creative Guarantee (CGI & Performance Pilot)
